test_fix_pdb_missing_residues: test cleanup.fix_pdb to add missing residues like GLY between CYS and LEU in a PDB structure
test_fix_pdb_missing_atoms: test cleanup.fix_pdb to add missing heavy atoms and hydrogens to a partial PRO residue
test_fix_pdb_remove_heterogens: test cleanup.fix_pdb to remove heterogen residues like HOH water molecules from a PDB structure
test_fix_pdb_nonstandard_residues: test cleanup.fix_pdb to convert nonstandard residue DAL to standard ALA in a PDB structure
test_replace_met_se: test cleanup._replace_met_se to replace selenium atoms with sulfur in MET residues of a PDB structure
